purpose: Empty sheet for a stopwatch timing of the same PDFs. It is not a measured result.
instructions: Review the packet PDFs with a stopwatch. Pause the watch when work stops.
Record work_seconds as the stopped time, with pauses left out.
Write findings as what the reviewer actually recorded, separated by semicolons.
Leave the sheet empty until a review happens. Do not copy the answer key into it.
Screen examples such as a minute count, a reduction percentage, or a defect fraction are layout only.

columns.name: reviewer_id
columns.description: Reviewer identifier for this manual session.

columns.name: packet_id
columns.description: Packet that was reviewed, such as TR-2026-001.

columns.name: mode
columns.description: This template records manual review only.

columns.name: work_seconds
columns.description: Stopwatch seconds of work, excluding pauses.

columns.name: fields_edited
columns.description: Fields the reviewer changed or wrote during the session.

columns.name: defects_found
columns.description: Count of defects the reviewer recorded. Scoring against the answer key happens later.

columns.name: findings
columns.description: Defects the reviewer recorded, separated by semicolons.

columns.name: marked_ready
columns.description: Whether the reviewer would export the packet.

columns.name: review_completed
columns.description: Whether the reviewer finished the session.
